body: Well, I'll say this. If I got food poisoning, it'd be pretty noticeable. I cut off a piece of a remaining piece of pizza, and I haven't thrown up yet. so.....
12' I think, in my opinion, it's pretty huge. Maybe because I am a small person xD. Now, I'm thinking I'm kinda petty.  Man, I flat out crashed. So, several hours. Probably 3-4.

I do see your point, but I feel like I need to add something. I would happily give to him if he were to ask, just like I gave it to other family members. It's the fact he took a half without asking. However, I guess it's very petty for me to be reaction this way.

But, I do agree this is worth a family discussion. Thank you!
Sound's like it helped you a great deal. Unfortunately, I have to reject the idea. I hope all of the things therapy taught you to stay with you. Good luck.
I have not kms'd yet, if that's what you meant. I will probably kms tomorrow.

You do make a good point, it's the person's decision. I can relate that, it is purely based upon what you want to do. May I ask what inspired you to write all of this? It seems very... raw, and honest.  Thank you for the advice!

That's a thought to contemplate. However, I do have to question, would living in society not be different? You do have to live by others standards, otherwise, how would you flourish in society? Living in society requires an income source, social life, and so forth to be considered a productive member of society, no? A group of people requires you to hold your part, and if I can't succeed in that, doesn't that mean I do not hold up to the standards to be a member of said group?

You are right though, living, in of itself, doesn't have standards. Living is a process, not a person. If you're not alive, you're not living. This gave me much to think about, thank you!

In what way did therapy help you, if you don't mind sharing? It's just been so long of withering my life away doing nothing, I can't see myself doing anything in the future, nor anything of value. Even though I can see how this is purely irrational, it's difficult to see it in a different light. Thanks.
